recentItems.title: Piper Gilles And Paul Poirier Dance to "Vincent" by Govardo ✨🎶 | Music Monday
recentItems.description:
📺 Re-live all the #MilanoCortina2026 action: https://go.olympics.com/watch 

Canadian powerhouses Piper Gilles and Paul Poirier brought the energy to the ice dance event at Milano Cortina 2026, dancing to "Vincent" by Govardo in the free dance. They claimed bronze with the stellar performance after taking fifth with team Canada in the figure skating team competition.
